evidence: The 152 m raceway lies inside La Guiguitte en Folie, a children's farm/leisure park in Filain (OSM theme_park with pirate-ship ride, bowling, arcade and animal enclosures within 150 m); it is a park ride, not a kart venue.

The dirt track is the 'Crazy Kart' family attraction inside the Pokeyland leisure park (OSM attraction node 30 m away; park site lists Crazy Kart with a 110 cm minimum height), next to 'Quad Kids', paintball and toboggans.
The way sits inside an OSM sports_centre named 'Circuit Mini Buggy' tagged sport=rc_car; it is a radio-controlled car track, mis-tagged as karting.

Small leisure=track at the Lac du Der port/resort area in Giffaumont next to minigolf, tree-climbing and a campsite; probably a holiday-resort attraction, but no source shows what kind of karts run there.

An asphalt kart complex is mapped here (pitch of ~1 km plus four sport=karting asphalt raceways) in fields by the Vierzon-Tours railway, but web searches found no circuit, club or operator in Gievres.

The untagged sport=karting area in Gresswiller sits next to the mapped 'Club de voitures radio-commandees MVHS', whose site says its asphalt and synthetic-turf off-road tracks are in Gresswiller; this is an RC-car track, not a kart track.
The 540 m track is inside the Didi'land amusement park (Morsbronn/Gunstett), where OSM shows an information board for 'Les F1'; the park describes Les F1 as a children's kart ride (95-140 cm).
The raceway is within the Loisirs Ocean amusement park at La Faute-sur-Mer (OSM theme_park 13 m away); the park's site advertises 'Babys Karts', a children's ride.
Two raceway ways (274 m) in a rural area with only hiking signposts nearby; no karting business, club or event was found for La Ferriere-aux-Etangs.
The sport=karting area adjoins a leisure=track tagged access=private in open countryside; no public venue or club was found online, so it looks like a private track.

A small asphalt karting area (about 100 x 100 m, access=customers) inside the municipal sports complex by Stade de Lamballe and Lycee Henri Avril; it is NOT the GP Circuit kart track, which OSM places 4.6 km away at Rue des Freres Pieto. Its use (school/road-safety or club mini-track) is unconfirmed.
An isolated leisure=pitch sport=karting in farmland with no other tagged features nearby; nothing about karting in Laneuveville-en-Saulnois was found online.

A 133 m track about 240 m from the Luna Park funfair at Les Mathes/La Palmyre and next to campsites; it is not at either known kart operator (AL Karting on Allee des Charmettes and Oceanic Aventure on Route de la Fouasse are both over 1 km away). It is probably a funfair or campsite kids' ride, but this is unconfirmed.
The 277 m raceway lies inside the Parc Bellevue amusement park in Limoges, among carousels, a slide and a 'Voitures Electriques' ride; it is a funfair attraction, not a kart venue.
A node tagged leisure=track sport=karting in Loix, beside tennis courts, a sports shop and a campsite playground; no karting on Ile de Re near Loix was found online.

The site is the track complex of ALC Longvic MRC, a radio-controlled car club (OSM club node 10 m away tagged piste_voiture_radio_commandee; club site: 'Pistes Voitures RC Loisirs et Competitions'). The karting-tagged raceways and asphalt pitches are RC-car tracks.

The 327 m raceway is 51 m from Motor'System (ZA Bonjuan, Magny). A Yumping listing says Motor System rents 270 cc karts on an outdoor track at La Chaume/Bonjuan, but its own site only mentions Can-Am quads, SSVs and an FFM cross terrain, so current kart rental is unconfirmed.
A sports_centre tagged sport=karting;boules with a karting pitch next to petanque pitches near the Nolongues sports complex; it may be a municipal or club mini-track, but nothing was found online.

A small network of raceway ways (269 m) next to a football pitch, a school and a travellers' site in Marles-les-Mines; no karting venue or club in the town was found, so it may be a children's or road-safety track.
An isolated leisure=track sport=karting (Bing 2011 trace) in farmland near the D23; no karting venue in Marmagne or near La Chapelle-Saint-Ursin was found online.
A 331 m asphalt raceway imported from the sports ministry's equipment census (2015), near the Puy Saint-Mary chapel above Mauriac; no operator or club was found online.

A 711 m asphalt kart raceway from the sports ministry's census, off the Route de Compiegne west of Soissons. The only local club found, A.S.K Soissons, is listed as racing at a 950 m Bucy-le-Long track, so it is not confirmed to be this one.
The raceways (458 m) adjoin La Recre des Trois Cures amusement park (theme_park 74 m away, among its rides and playgrounds); this is a park attraction track, not a stand-alone kart venue.

An asphalt karting area in the grounds of the Chateau de Chalendrat site in Mirefleurs, whose buildings are named 'Batiment ados', 'Infirmerie' and 'Ateliers' (apparently a youth institution); it looks like an on-site private track, but this is unconfirmed.

A small raceway area among residential towers on Avenue Gloria (Magnan, Nice), next to a private garden and car-park entrance; no karting at this spot was found. It may be a private or children's track or a mis-tag.

The element is tagged disused:highway=raceway with landuse=grass, and the nearby raceway is also disused, beside the Terril 43 slag heap near Loisinord. It is a former track that has been grassed over, not an active kart track.
A large mapped complex of about 19 kart raceway segments near Claret/Pompignan suggests a substantial circuit, but no circuit name, operator or club was found online.
Two raceway ways (418 m) in countryside near Ty Nouet hamlet, Poullaouen; no karting venue or club was found online.

A kart raceway node from the sports ministry's 2025 census, sitting on a leisure=track tagged access=private reached by a private track; no public operator was found, so it appears to be a private track.

name: Euro Dieppe Karting
evidence: Euro Dieppe Karting is mapped here (named track area and building) in the Zone d'activite Verte, Rouxmesnil-Bouteilles; a tourism guide lists kart rental on outdoor and indoor tracks at this address. The listed website eurodieppekarting.fr no longer resolves, so check that the venue still operates.

name: Karting de Royan
evidence: The building stands beside a lit asphalt karting pitch on Rue d'Arsonval, Royan, which is the address of Karting de Royan (Circuit de la Cote de Beaute, 13 rue d'Arsonval). That 600 m approved track rents karts to drivers aged 7 and over. Duplicate of the existing Karting de Royan entry way/724274244 (same venue, building at the address).
An isolated 637 m raceway in the countryside near Quinson/Regusse; the only feature nearby is a private pool. No karting venue was found online, so it may be private.

A 299 m raceway near the hamlet of Lascot in Saint-Genies. A directory lists 'Karting Cross' in Saint-Genies with its own track (drivers aged 8+), but classifies it as pedal-kart rental, and its location and vehicle type are unconfirmed.
The raceways are inside the Laby'Parc leisure park (theme_park 70 m away), whose website lists pedal karting ('karting a pedales') among its activities.

name: SpeedPark Le Mans
evidence: The node is inside the 'SpeedPark Le Mans' building (ZAC des Portes de l'Oceane, Saint-Saturnin), an indoor centre that tourism listings say has karting on 2 circuits plus bowling and laser tag.
A 311 m raceway (plus a raceway multipolygon) in fields near the Bijude picnic area off the D1; no karting venue or club at Saint-Vaast-la-Hougue was found online.

OSM notes on the way and on the gate say it is a kart track abandoned for several years, overgrown with brambles and gorse, and closed off by a private-property sign. It is no longer a usable kart track.
A 1531 m raceway near Saval in rural Savignac-sur-Leyze, a length typical of a competition kart circuit, but no circuit, club or event was found online.
Two asphalt kart raceways (321 m) with no other tagged features nearby; no karting venue in Savonnieres-devant-Bar or Bar-le-Duc was found online.
